name: hoppy-claude-code
displayName: Claude Usage Tracker, Multi-Account Switcher & Voice to Text - Hoppy
description: See your Claude Code usage limits (exact 5-hour and weekly %) live in the status bar. Keep multiple Claude accounts logged in and switch in one click without losing your chat context. Hit a limit? Continue the same chat on another account or on free AI models (Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Groq and 20 more). Voice to text in any language, including Bangla, with automatic translation. Not affiliated with Anthropic.

hoppy.autoStartGateway.description: Start the claude-code-router gateway when VS Code opens.

hoppy.syncChatsOnSwitch.description: When switching, copy this project's chats from your other accounts and Other AI so /resume shows all of them. Originals are never changed.

hoppy.accountColors.description: Status bar color per Claude account folder, e.g. {"C:\Users\me\.claude": "#FF6B8B"}. Set it from Hoppy Settings → Accounts.

hoppy.showUsage.description: Show tokens used per account (last 5 hours, today, this week) in the Hoppy menu and settings. Counted from Claude Code's local chat files; Anthropic's exact plan limits are not public, so this is a guide, not a percentage.

hoppy.projectAccounts.description: Projects pinned to a Claude account or Other AI: project folder to account folder. Set it from the Hoppy menu with Always use ... in this project.

enumDescriptions: Continue on the next Claude account that is not at its limit (Other AI if none)
hoppy.onLimit.description: What Hoppy does when a Claude account hits its limit. Hoppy offers to set this after your first hop.

hoppy.suggestOnLimit.description: When a Claude account hits its session or weekly limit, offer to continue the chat on another account or Other AI. Hoppy reads only Claude Code's local chat files; nothing is sent anywhere.

hoppy.accountLabels.description: Friendly names for Claude account folders, e.g. { "C:\\Users\\me\\.claude": "Work" }.

hoppy.routerConfigDir.description: Claude Code config folder used for Other AI Models mode.

hoppy.claudeConfigDirs.description: Extra Claude Code config folders to search for chats to hand off. ~/.claude and ~/.claude-account* are always searched.

hoppy.customProviders.markdownDescription: Your own OpenAI-compatible providers (added in Hoppy Settings > AI Providers). Keys are kept in the OS secret store, not here.

hoppy.providerOptions.markdownDescription: Per-provider values that are not secret: Cloudflare account ID, address of a local server (Ollama, LM Studio).

hoppy.showCommunityProviders.markdownDescription: Show community gateways (Kilo, LLM7, Pollinations) in AI Providers. They are free, but prompts may be logged.

hoppy.fallbackModels.description: Models the gateway tries, in order, when the selected model fails.

hoppy.mainModel.description: Default model for Other AI Models mode (Opus/Sonnet/Fable slots).

hoppy.claudeQuota.markdownDescription: Show the exact 5-hour and weekly % used for each Claude account, read from Anthropic (the same numbers as Claude Code's /usage). Hoppy only reads the account's current login token; it never refreshes, changes or stores it. Off: Hoppy shows tokens from local chat files and an estimate.

hoppy.usageColor.markdownDescription: Font color of the usage item (`5h 2% · wk 60%`). `auto`: green, amber from 70% used, theme color on a yellow/red box. Or any hex color, e.g. `#ffffff`, used always. Empty: theme default.

enumDescriptions: Yellow box from 80% used, red from 95%
hoppy.usageBackground.markdownDescription: Background of the usage item in the status bar. VS Code lets extensions use only yellow or red here. To change what that yellow looks like, set `statusBarItem.warningBackground` in `workbench.colorCustomizations` (affects every extension).

hoppy.voice.show.markdownDescription: Show the **Voice** button in the status bar. Click it, speak, click again: the text goes into the Claude chat input, not sent. Shortcut: `Ctrl+Alt+Shift+V`.

enumDescriptions: Claude Code dictation (no key) for English, Hindi and 18 more; Gemini (or Groq) for Bangla, translation and Other AI
Always Claude Code dictation: no key, 20 languages (not Bangla), Claude accounts only
Gemini Flash-Lite listens to the audio: best Bangla in tests (names like রাজশাহী, ঢাকা right). Free key; on the free tier Google may use data to improve products
Groq Whisper large v3: fastest, free key, no training on your data; weaker Bangla spelling
hoppy.voice.engine.markdownDescription: Which service turns speech into text. **Auto**: no setup for English, Hindi and 18 more languages (Claude Code dictation). Bangla and translation use Gemini if you have a Gemini key (most accurate in tests), else Groq. Audio is sent only when you stop a recording.

hoppy.voice.spokenLanguage.markdownDescription: The language you speak. **Any language** detects it each time and handles Bangla mixed with English words best. Quick change: hover the Voice button → I speak.

hoppy.voice.outputLanguage.markdownDescription: Language of the written text. **Same as spoken** writes what you said; any other choice translates (e.g. speak Bangla, get English). Quick change: hover the Voice button → Write in.

enumDescriptions: Claude chat input (not sent; you review and press Enter)
Wherever your cursor is (editor, terminal with Claude CLI, any input)

hoppy.voice.cleanUp.markdownDescription: Groq/OpenAI only: after speech-to-text, ask a model to fix spelling. Off by default: in tests it sometimes changed or dropped words. Gemini needs no clean-up.

hoppy.voice.words.markdownDescription: Your own words Voice should always spell right: names, project and tech words, Bangla words it gets wrong (e.g. `Hoppy`, `শুদ্ধ`, `ড্যাশবোর্ড`). Sent as a spelling hint with each recording. Up to 50.

hoppy.voice.debug.markdownDescription: Keep the last recording and its raw and final text on this PC (Hoppy's storage folder, path shown in Output → Hoppy) to check accuracy. Overwritten each time; off by default.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Hoppy
walkthroughs.description: Use all your Claude accounts and other AI models in the Claude panel. A short video, then 5 steps.

steps.title: Watch how it works
steps.description:
New to Hoppy? See it in action first. The overview takes 2 minutes; the tutorial shows every feature step by step.
[Watch the overview (2 min)](https://youtu.be/zhqcQeih3do)
[Watch the full tutorial (4 min)](https://youtu.be/Sl9I1QzJ-zs)

media.altText: Hoppy video: switch Claude accounts and AI models in one click.

steps.title: Switch in one click
steps.description:
Click **Claude** in the status bar (bottom right). A list opens **at the top of VS Code**: pick an account or **Other AI**. A new Claude tab opens on it right away.
Also: **Settings → Accounts**, or **Ctrl+Shift+P → Hoppy: Switch**. No button? Right-click the status bar and tick **Hoppy**.
[Try it now](command:hoppy.menu)

media.altText: Step 1: click the Claude item in the status bar at the bottom. Step 2: the Hoppy list opens at the top of VS Code; pick a Claude account or Other AI.

steps.title: Add another Claude account
steps.description:
Optional. Use a work and a personal account side by side: add it, give it a name, then log in in the new Claude tab.
[Add Claude account](command:hoppy.addAccount)

media.altText: Step 1: click Add Claude account and name it. Step 2: log in with that account in the new Claude tab.

steps.title: Connect other AI models
steps.description:
Click **Connect** on a service, paste its key, and Hoppy checks it before saving. Free choices: OpenRouter (15+ free models), Gemini, Groq, Cerebras, Mistral, NVIDIA. Paid: DeepSeek, GLM.
[Connect a service](command:hoppy.settings?%5B%22providers%22%5D)

media.altText: OpenRouter card: 1 get a key, 2 paste it in the box, 3 click Test and save. A green check confirms the key works.

steps.title: Hit a limit? Hoppy keeps you going
steps.description:
When a Claude account hits its limit, Hoppy asks where to continue. One click and the same chat opens on your other account or Other AI. When the limit resets, Hoppy tells you.
You can also move any chat yourself:
[Continue a chat](command:hoppy.handoff)

media.altText: Step 1: Claude says the account hit its session limit. Step 2: Hoppy asks, with buttons Continue on Personal, Continue on Other AI, and Choose. Step 3: the same chat opens in a new tab; send a message and carry on.

steps.title: See your Claude usage at a glance
steps.description:
The status bar shows how much of your 5-hour and weekly Claude limit is used, the same numbers as /usage. Hover for every account; click for the side view.
[Open Hoppy Usage](command:hoppy.usageView.focus)

steps.title: Talk to Claude with Voice
steps.description:
Click Voice in the status bar, speak, click again: the text lands in the Claude chat box. English and 19 more languages need nothing; Bangla and translation use your Gemini or Groq key.
[Try Voice](command:hoppy.voiceToggle)
[Pick output language](command:hoppy.voiceLanguage)

steps.title: Optional extras
steps.description:
**Ctrl+Alt+H** switches back to the last account or model. Pin a project to one account from the Hoppy menu. In **Settings → Backups**, click **Check models** to see which work right now.
[Check backups](command:hoppy.settings?%5B%22fallback%22%5D)
[Install /second-opinion](command:hoppy.installSkill)

media.altText: Left: backup models tried top to bottom. Right: asking nemotron for a second opinion from inside a Claude chat.
